_about: Goals & Schedules (refine, seventh pass, 2026-11-24): the page holds only what the simple Goal has (DL-477, DL-478, GRS-048 to GRS-054, Settings_System's Goals row): what a new Goal may change, interruptions, watching progress and the progress view (Goals); the rows for timed runs (Schedules); the receipt and what it keeps (Proof). The five ids DL-478 retired are drawn nowhere. The rows about checking planned work, which the Plans keep live, move to Planning › Planning & Interviews in their own three groups. Settings still only sets defaults: Goals are started, watched and stopped in the assistant chat.
